summary: After deploying the MCP server, collect the AAP login URL (Networking > Routes), the admin password (aap-admin-password secret, Reveal values) and the MCP server URL from the aap-mcp route, then create an API token.
questions: What is the Ansible MCP server URL?
Where do I find the AAP admin password for the MCP setup?
What do I need to connect an AI agent to the MCP server?
